extracted.intended_audience: students and readers of philosophy; reflective writers interested in time, movement, and language
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for representing temporal flow, movement, and the relation between form and becoming in prose or poetry; emphasizes how language and signs handle (and fail to fully handle) continuity and change. Useful for writers who wish to render duration and process rather than static snapshots.

rubrics_metrics.name: More in movement than snapshots
rubrics_metrics.description: There is _more_ in a movement than in the successive positions attributed to the moving object, _more_ in a becoming than in the forms passed through in turn, _more_ in the evolution of form than the forms assumed one after another.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not reduce movement to a mere series of static positions or consecutive 'snapshots'. When depicting motion or change, aim to convey what exceeds the enumerated states — the qualitative surplus, the continuity and life that the succession alone does not capture. (The passage contrasts the cinematographical instinct of thought with the inadequate capture of becoming by snapshots.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Treat duration as the life of things (avoid privileging static Forms)
rubrics_metrics.description: He who installs himself in becoming sees in duration the very life of things. The Forms... are then only snapshots of the changing reality. They are moments gathered along the course of time; and, just because we have cut the thread that binds them to time, they no longer endure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make duration central: represent temporality as constitutive rather than peripheral. Avoid treating a form or 'ideal' state as the essence of a thing; instead show how identity emerges across time and flow. Resist presenting static 'Forms' as the true reality of characters/events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acknowledge language's limitation: it expresses Forms, only suggests mobility
rubrics_metrics.description: Forms are all that [language] is capable of expressing. It is reduced to taking as understood or is limited to suggesting a mobility which, just because it is always unexpressed, is thought to remain in all cases the same.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware that words primarily fix aspects of experience; they tend to objectify. To convey movement or becoming, use strategies of suggestion — sequences of images, rhythm, tense shifts, sensory detail — rather than relying on abstract statements that 'name' a Form and thereby flatten temporality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use successive bounds (images/phrases) to lead readers from words to the generative idea
rubrics_metrics.description: Our ear only hears the words: it therefore perceives only accidents. But our mind, by successive bounds, leaps from the words to the images, from the images to the original idea, and so gets back, from the perception of words--accidents called up by accidents--to the conception of the Idea that posits its own being.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Arrange words and images so readers can make the intended mental leaps: craft sequences that accumulate and suggest the underlying generative idea. Recognize that readers reconstruct the idea from presented 'accidents', so design those accidents (phrases, images, motifs) to cue and converge on the intended perception of continuity or essence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid privileging 'characteristic' or 'privileged' moments; depict any moment precisely
rubrics_metrics.description: Ancient science thinks it knows its object sufficiently when it has noted of it some privileged moments, whereas modern science considers the object at any moment whatever.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not rely solely on iconic, exemplary instants (the 'privileged moment') to stand for a whole process. Instead, attend to arbitrary instants within a process; render them with precision to reveal dynamics that a single emblematic scene would conceal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Break time into many fine-grained moments; favour quantitative/continuous detail
rubrics_metrics.description: Modern science... applies to magnitudes and proposes first and foremost to measure them... modern science must be defined pre-eminently by its aspiration to take time as an independent variable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In narrative or description, subdivide duration and give fine-grained detail of change (rhythm, gesture, small shifts). This can be rendered through pacing, micro-descriptions, repeated focalizations, or sequences that register quantitative/qualitative variation across instants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Beware of converting perceptions into eternal concepts (avoid reification)
rubrics_metrics.description: They tend to withdraw into their own definition, that is to say, into the artificial reconstruction and symbolical expression which is their intellectual equivalent. They enter into eternity, if you will; but what is eternal in them is just what is unreal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid letting striking images or conceptual summaries harden into abstract 'eternal' truths that erase temporal complexity. Keep sensory immediacy and the tension of becoming; resist summarizing a dynamic scene into a neat, timeless aphorism that cancels its lived temporality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the cinematographical method deliberately but preserve continuity
rubrics_metrics.description: Our perception and thought begin by substituting for the continuity of evolutionary change a series of unchangeable forms which are turn by turn, 'caught on the wing'... Science... handles signs, which it substitutes for the objects themselves... they are none the less tied down to the general condition of the sign, which is to denote a fixed aspect of the reality under an arrested form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shot-like, snapshot techniques (short scenes, cuts, discrete images) are useful, but their use must be tempered by devices that preserve or imply flow (transition, rhythm, returning motifs). Recognize that 'signs' fix aspects; ensure your montage of signs reconstructs movement rather than merely listing frozen instants.
